text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: As uncompromising as ever... I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(...Though nothing is forever immutable, I 
doubt the winds of change will blow 
easily. At the very least, not if things 
remain as they are.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(Countless Horse Girls chase their dreams 
alongside worthy rivals, inspiring one 
another and honing their skills together.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(Yet if I were to suggest forging such a 
bond to Sirius... she would only scoff at 
me.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: (...How, then, should I reach out to her?)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Ha. A strange predicament to ponder, 
even for myself. It feels almost as if I 
were a child fumbling through trial and 
error to make my very first friend.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My, isn't that quite the endearing 
dilemma?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki. ...So you overheard.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're thinking about Sirius-senpai, 
right? Word reached me that you two had 
quite the stare-down the other day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They say a secret shared is a secret no 
more, but rumors truly do travel fast.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is just worried about you two. 
Still... I can't help but wonder if things 
might actually be fine just the way they 
are.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Remaining in this present state, you 
mean?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. After all, isn't there a certain fire 
that can only ignite between the two of 
you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished training and heading back 
toward my room, I caught sight of Symboli 
Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's you. We meet again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, she had mentioned her 
relationship with Sirius Symboli 
earlier... I decided to ask her about how 
things were going.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Fuji Kiseki gave me something to 
consider. What kind of fire is born 
between the two of us? I have been 
contemplating that question.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Short of an extraordinary turn of 
events, my relationship with Sirius will 
not suddenly undergo a complete change of 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Though we may reflect upon ourselves, it 
remains difficult for either of us to 
digest those feelings. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you stand near vermilion, you are 
stained red... The heat born of such a 
dynamic must surely be clouded. Would that 
truly serve as nourishment for the Horse 
Girls, I wonder?
choice_data_list: Why not show them that it can?
I believe it all comes down to you.
I think it depends on you, President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you stand near vermilion, you are 
stained red... The heat born of such a 
dynamic must surely be clouded. Would that 
truly serve as nourishment for the Horse 
Girls, I wonder?
choice_data_list: Why not show them that it can?
I believe it all comes down to you.
I think it depends on you, President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Show them...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Sirius Symboli directs toward Symboli 
Rudolf is surely not 'hatred'.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though I have no concrete proof and cannot 
verify it, I can't help but sense 
something entirely different beneath it 
all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Something other than 'hatred', you say? 
Yet even if I were to try to embrace such 
an uncertain emotion, she would only—
choice_data_list: Then clash with her even more directly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's impossible to simply absorb an 
emotion whose true nature is unknown. If 
so, it's better to clash head-on and each 
press forward toward your own 
destinations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if your paths never cross. The power 
to keep surging forward despite crashing 
into one another ought to generate a pure, 
unclouded heat, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A brilliant brilliance that captivates and 
draws in all who behold it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Because I attempted to simply 
absorb it, it became distorted. Perhaps 
pure passion takes a much simpler and 
clearer form.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case... then all I must do 
is press forward to meet her head-on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—You have my gratitude. You have helped me 
reaffirm what I ought to do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Letting slip a faint smile, Symboli Rudolf 
looked up at the sky with a refreshed 
expression.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Down to me? ...Can it truly be resolved as 
a matter of my own doing alone?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter what intense passion is thrown 
your way, as long as the one receiving it 
possesses the resolve—
choice_data_list:
You should be able to heighten it or cool 
it down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You just have to demonstrate that to those 
around you. That any fire can be shaped in 
whichever way you choose, and that there 
is nothing to fear.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
How I receive her... ...You suggest I put 
that on display?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. That has always been my way, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To show my back and forge the path. Thus, 
if I remain composed and unwavering, the 
others will have no cause for distress.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. It is precisely as you say. 
Fufu. When it comes to her, it seems I end 
up growing a bit too heated myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I shall turn even that heat into 
nourishment. So that all may live their 
days in peaceful harmony within this 
academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her cool, poised smile, Symboli 
Rudolf exuded a majestic dignity truly 
worthy of the title 'Emperor'.
